violations.description: General employee practices. — --- Employee drink found in prep cooler
Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food - Cooked chicken found below raw pork in prep cooler.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. - Items in prep cooler undated

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Prep cooler found with black growth inside above open containers of food.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -All Equipment, shelves, need to be deep cleaned. - A/C units needs to be cleaned. - Exhaust fan needs to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. - Hand sink found dirty.--Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. - Saniti bucket found in hand wash station.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors needed to be deep cleaned.
Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insect electrocution or trapping device was installed in an inappropriate location - Flystrips found in food truck in unapproved locations.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Wet Cloth found without saniti bucket.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. - Top of prep cooler is ice filled/cooled. Corrected on site, more ice added, lowered container into ice.

Reheating food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not reheated rapidly so all parts reached a temperature of 165F for 15 seconds within one hour. - Beer Cheese, sauerkraut found at 145-155 after 2 hours of heating- Sent to landfill

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Equipment, shelves, need to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. - Handwash station leaking, not working at time of inspection. -Prep table drains into pan on floor and not into disposal.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. - Handwash station not working at time of inspection. Leaking.
